Implementation of share/completions/_macacfs (zsh) and share/completions/macacfs.bash; it [[fb-share-completions|serves|These two files are the concrete completion scripts the completions bead names.]]. Both complete the verbs (install, update, list, newproj, new, config, schedule, self-update, version, help), tool names read from share/manifest.tsv, every newproj flag in all three modes including --github[=private|public], --no-github, --github-owner, --ru and --no-ru, the config subcommands and keys, and the valid values for each key. The managed zshrc puts the zsh one on fpath before Oh My Zsh runs compinit, and the bash one is sourced by hand. The flag list [[fb-lib-newproj-core-impl|couples-with|The completions list newproj's flags, so they must track its argument parsers.]].
